messages:
sara (support): FYI CoralHealth's AP team just replied — they will not accept an invoice until they have a PO number and supplier tax ID on file. they said 'no PO = no payment' :grimacing:

tim (acct-mgmt): Ugh, do we have a PO requirement flag for that account already?

jessica (finance): Not that I'm seeing. CoralHealth is on net-30 per contract but procurement insists on a supplier PO before they accept invoices. we can add PO field to next invoice but need direction: do we wait for their PO or send a proforma? :thinking_face:

oliver (solutions): They mentioned vendor code + VAT number specifically. Quote from AP: "we need Redwood's VAT + our PO reference on the invoice or it will be rejected by our ERP."

sara (support): AP attached their standard form. short answer from customer: they will only issue the PO after legal confirms SOW and the vendor lookup completes — could be a week.

jessica (finance): two options: (1) hold invoice issuance until we receive their PO (clean but delays revenue recognition), (2) issue a proforma / quote with the invoice fields populated except PO and mark as "pending PO" in our ledger so collections team can chase. which do we prefer?

tim (acct-mgmt): For enterprise accounts we usually accept a PO on file before invoicing if their processes require it. suggest we send proforma and request the exact PO number and vendor code. put a note: "Invoice will be issued on receipt of PO: <PO#>". keeps them moving.

jessica (finance): ok. I'll draft a proforma template. Need copy of the AP email and vendor lookup form to attach. sara can you paste attachments here?

sara (support): dropping the form and AP email below. also included the vendor field they want added: ``PO reference: ______`` and ``Supplier VAT/GST: ______``

billing-bot: Invoice draft created (draft_id: inv-draft-20260305-88). Status: DRAFT.

oliver (solutions): handy email to send them:
````
Hi Kara / AP team,

Thanks for the note. Attached is a proforma for the charges this period. We can issue a formal invoice as soon as you provide your PO number and vendor code. Please send the PO to billing@redwood-example.com and include your vendor VAT number.

If you'd prefer, we can wait to issue the invoice until legal confirms the SOW — let us know which you prefer.

Thanks,
Oliver (Redwood)
````

tim (acct-mgmt): That reads fine. Add a line that the proforma is not payable until an official invoice is issued. keeps the accounting correct.

jessica (finance): I'll attach our supplier VAT and company details to speed their vendor lookup: ``Company: Redwood Inference, VAT: GB123456789, DUNS: 12-345-6789``

sara (support): Sent to customer at 11:03AM with attachments and proforma. cc'ing legal and finance.

billing-bot: Customer reply received (CoralHealth AP): "We can issue PO after vendor code created. Estimate 5-7 business days."

tim (acct-mgmt): Okay— I'll mark the account as "awaiting PO" in CRM and schedule a follow-up for 7 business days.

jessica (finance): Recording note: revenue recognition hold flagged. If PO doesn't arrive by 2026-03-18 we'll follow up and consider issuing a delayed invoice once PO confirmed.

sara (support): closing loop here. If anything changes I'll update this thread. :white_check_mark:
